incident.title: Customer web portal completely unavailable
incident.alert_or_symptom: Customers cannot load or use the customer web portal.

technical_evidence.observation: All 240 customer-portal checks from United Kingdom and Ireland monitoring locations failed between 08:02 and 08:12, with no successful page load recorded.
Requests to the customer-portal entry point returned HTTP 503 from every monitored location. The response contained no component-specific diagnostic information.
Customers report that the portal home page, sign-in entry page and checkout pages are inaccessible.
No application, edge, storage, API, authentication, compute, database or configuration failure has yet been directly identified.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Customers across the United Kingdom and Ireland cannot access the web portal or complete online purchases.

environmental_context: The Customer Web Portal is a Tier 1 business-critical customer-facing service.
The portal depends on the edge platform, object storage, Public API Gateway and Identity and Access Service.
No alternative customer channel has been approved as a workaround.
reported_unknowns: The directly responsible technical component or failure condition has not been identified.
The current health of each portal dependency has not yet been independently confirmed.
The expected duration of the outage is unknown.
additional_context: No data loss, corruption or serious security exposure has been reported.

model_output.incident_summary: The Customer Web Portal is completely unavailable across the United Kingdom and Ireland, impacting 28,000 users who cannot access or complete online purchases.
